frontmatter.title: What is Elixir? An Introduction to Functional Power on the BEAM

frontmatter.excerpt: Learn what Elixir is, why it's gaining popularity among developers, and how its functional paradigm and the BEAM VM make it ideal for scalable, fault-tolerant applications.
